The selected ordering is C0 provider-neutral contract and deterministic extractor, C1 Datalog actual-corpus query, C2 Alloy bounded counterexample over the same fact digest and scope, then C3 a non-inflating joined receipt; implementation remains blocked until L0 lifecycle reconciliation plus L1 or an explicitly accepted replan.
